def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None, cart_id="123"):
    return CartPosition(
        item=item, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id=cart_id,
        used_membership=membership,
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_membership_required(event, customer):
    ticket = Item.objects.create(event=event, name='Day ticket', default_price=Decimal('23.00'), admission=True)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, ticket)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event, lock=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_missing(event, customer, requiring_ticket):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)], event)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_wrong_type(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Other")
    membership.membership_type = other_type
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_variation_types_override_item_types(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Other")
    var = requiring_ticket.variations.create(value="A", require_membership=True)
    var.require_membership_types.add(other_type)
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp.variation = var
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):

    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(other, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)

    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_expired(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [_cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)], event,
                                      valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_not_yet_started_and_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, membership,
                                                                        requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start += timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end += timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_in_purchase(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, cart_id="a")
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, cart_id="a")
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    order = Order.objects.create(
        code='MEM1', event=event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
        status=Order.STATUS_PAID, locale='en',
        datetime=now(), expires=now() + timedelta(days=10),
        total=23,
        sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        customer=customer,
    )
    op = OrderPosition.objects.create(
        order=order, item=requiring_ticket, variation=None, price=Decimal("23.00"),
        attendee_name_parts={'_scheme': 'full', 'full_name': "Peter"}, positionid=1,
        used_membership=membership,
    )
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    # Changing that very order keeps its own usage out of the count
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [op], event, ignored_order=order)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)
